title: The snapshot file format
text: JSON can represent numbers, strings, booleans, arrays, objects, null. R values need information, shinysnap uses JSON object $type field. objects called typed wrappers . NULL null. atomic vector length one without names JSON scalar; longer vectors arrays. Since R scalar type, scalar array length one read back value. vector length zero typed wrapper, {"$type": "<storage>", "value": []}, bare [] type. Logicals true false. Strings escaped required RFC 8259, characters outside ASCII kept UTF-8. Integers use digits without decimal point. Doubles use fewest digits read back value, given zmij::format_double(). finite double always contains . e, 1 integer 1.0 double. NA inside vector length greater one null position; elements determine type. vector entirely NA, including single NA, typed wrapper null values, NULL, NA, NA_character_ stay distinct. Infinite values NaN use strings "inf", "-inf", "NaN" inside double wrapper, used value present. Named atomic vectors {"$type": "<storage>", "names": [...], "value": [...]}. Dates, times, durations, factors use wrappers: Date: {"$type": "Date", "value": ["2024-01-01", null]}. POSIXct: {"$type": "POSIXct", "tz": "UTC", "value": ["2024-01-01T10:00:00.000Z"]}. Values written stored time zone rounded milliseconds. tz key omitted time zone attribute. UTC values use offset Z; values using session’s time zone formatted UTC also use Z. difftime: {"$type": "difftime", "units": "secs", "value": [...]}. Factors: {"$type": "factor", "levels": [...], "value": ["", null]}, "ordered": true ordered factors. matrix array {"$type": "array", "storage": "double", "dim": [2, 3], "dimnames": [["", "b"], null], "value": [...]} values ordered column, R. reader also accepts "matrix" type. data frame {"$type": "data.frame", "nrow": 3, "columns": {"x": ..., "y": ...}}, "row.names" array row names automatic ones. Tibbles written data frames. list whose names present unique JSON object. list (unnamed, partially named, empty) {"$type": "list", "names": [...], "value": [...]} names omitted absent, except unnamed list least one element scalar written JSON array, reads back list. Anything else (environments, functions, S4 R6 objects, unknown classes) error default. unsupported = "rds" becomes {"$type": "rds", "class": [...], "base64": "..."} (bundle, {"$type": "rds", "class": [...], "path": "objects/1-values_fit.rds"}). Reading requires trust = TRUE; otherwise decode NULL one warning lists . Attributes listed dropped writing. Keys starting $ reserved.
